title: Personal Agent — user.tool_stack Record
description: Schema for a single record in the user.tool_stack pack (#10 of 14): the tools, libraries, services, and commands the subject reaches for — which ones they prefer for a job, how they actually use them, and which ones they deliberately avoid (ToolPreference node). Each record extends the unified base record via allOf $ref to ./record.base.schema.json and narrows record_type to this pack's three types. Routed from ToolPreferenceCandidate (see ../spec/01-kernel-schema.md §6 routing); tool targets surface as `resource` in the OpenCrab 9-space crosswalk (../spec/07-opencrab-9space-crosswalk.md). Gate G4 applies: describe the observed choice and usage, not guessed taste. Pack definition: ../spec/03-pack-catalog.md (user.tool_stack); base record: ../spec/01-kernel-schema.md §7. (구 코드명: t10.)

record_type.description: Tool-stack record kind. ToolPreferenceRecord = the subject's default or favored choice for a job, including the 'reach for X over Y' selection (the `statement` says what is preferred and why, in behavioral terms). ToolUsageRecord = how the subject actually uses a tool — the habitual flags, settings, invocation patterns, or conventions observed in sessions (substance lives in `usage_pattern`). ToolAvoidanceRecord = a tool/feature the subject deliberately avoids or forbids, and what they use instead (pairs with `instead_use`); compiles into a soft constraint the runtime respects within scope.

tool_name.description: Canonical name of the tool/library/service/command this record is about (e.g. 'ripgrep', 'pytest', 'GitHub CLI', 'Postgres'). Identifies the `resource` target; keep the human-canonical name and put variants in base `aliases`.

tool_category.description: Coarse classification of the tool, used for retrieval and for matching a task to the right tool. Optional; the base `statement` stays canonical.

purpose.description: The job-to-be-done this tool is chosen/used/avoided for, in behavioral language (e.g. 'fast code search across the repo', 'schema migrations', 'PR review'). Refines the required base `scope` into a checkable surface (Gate G2) without weakening it.

preferred_over.description: For ToolPreferenceRecord: alternatives this tool is chosen ahead of for the stated `purpose` (e.g. ['grep', 'ack']). Makes the preference an ordering an evaluator (artifact_fit) can score, not a bare like.

instead_use.description: For ToolAvoidanceRecord: the tool(s) the subject reaches for in place of the avoided one (e.g. avoid 'os.system' → ['subprocess.run']). The constructive half of an avoidance rule, so the runtime has a substitute rather than just a prohibition.

usage_pattern.description: For ToolUsageRecord: the observed habitual way of invoking/configuring the tool — flags, settings, conventions, or a representative command (e.g. 'rg with --hidden and -g to scope globs', 'pytest -x to stop on first failure'). Refines `statement` into the concrete, reproducible usage an evaluator can check.

binding.description: How firmly the runtime should honor this record within scope. required/forbidden are hard constraints; preferred/discouraged are soft leanings overridable by a stronger cue; default is a starting choice a later signal can change. Distinct from `confidence` (evidence strength), which measures how well-supported the record is, not how hard it binds.

applies_to_tasks.description: Task kinds/contexts where this tool choice is in effect (e.g. ['code search', 'data migration', 'CI config']). Narrows the required base `scope` into checkable surfaces; complements base `linked_projects`/`linked_domains`.

$comment: Required fields are inherited unchanged from record.base.schema.json (id, record_type, label, statement, evidence_refs, confidence, scope, review_status, sensitivity, created_at, updated_at); only record_type is constrained here. All fields added by this pack are OPTIONAL — required = base required + record_type, per the pack-focus rule. Base validation still applies: evidence_refs ≥ 1 (G1), non-empty scope (G2), counterexamples required when confidence < 0.7, exception_rules required when sensitivity ∈ {sensitive, restricted}. Display aliases for `statement`: a UI may show 'tool_rule'/'preference', but the stored canonical field is `statement`. record_type is constrained to the three user.tool_stack types; routed from ToolPreferenceCandidate (spec/01-kernel-schema.md §6). tool_name/preferred_over/instead_use targets are the `resource` space in the 9-space crosswalk (구 코드명 t10).
